isolation: greeter is a stateless read-only GET endpoint with no persisted state and no container to create; each scenario asserts only on the HTTP response to its own request

scenarios.rule: A request naming a person receives a greeting addressed to them

steps.text: an API Consumer calls GET /hello with name "Alice"
steps.observed: no UI exists for this component (API-only service); the request was made directly against the deployed HTTP endpoint named in the validation context

steps.text: the response is a JSON greeting addressed to "Alice"
steps.observed: HTTP 200, body {"name":"Alice","message":"Hello, Alice!"} — message addressed to Alice

scenarios.rule: A request with no name still receives a generic greeting rather than an error

steps.text: an API Consumer calls GET /hello with no name
steps.observed: no UI exists for this component (API-only service); the request was made directly against the deployed HTTP endpoint named in the validation context

steps.text: the response is a generic JSON greeting
steps.observed: HTTP 200, body {"message":"Hello, World!"} — generic greeting, no error, no "name" field
